t_advice_summary_textbox.text: If you choose one coloured gnome and there's less mushroom in the basket, choose the opposite coloured gnome, and there'd be more mushrooms in the basket and that also both gnomes have different coloured baskets and that the colour of the baskets depend on how much you get, so look out for that too!

vb_textbox.text: Well I noticed that the gnomes that are pink, red, brown and purple always have the red baskets - the red baskets will always give you mushrooms and ample amount of mushrooms when you have the "X5" Multiplier as well as the other coloured gnomes which have the yellow basket...the yellow basket usually has less mushrooms especially when you get the "X1" multiplier.
